category_rationale: Managing and annotating photographic evidence of property conditions.

do_nothing_test.note: inspection_report.png does not exist before agent acts. Returns score=0 immediately.

partial_test.example: Agent draws one colored box but no text and exports. Criteria 1 (file exists), 2 (modified), 3 (some vivid color) pass; 4 (only 1 zone) and 5 (dimensions) are borderline. Score ~40-60%.

verification_criteria.label: inspection_report.png exists and is valid
verification_criteria.check: File exists on Desktop, PIL can open it

verification_criteria.label: Image modified from source
verification_criteria.check: Mean pixel diff > 2.0 OR > 1% pixels changed by > 20 value

verification_criteria.label: At least 3 distinct annotation zones
verification_criteria.check: ≥3 of 5×6 grid blocks contain vivid pixels (>3% vivid)

verification_criteria.label: Dimensions match or exceed source
verification_criteria.check: Output width ≥ source width - 50 AND height ≥ source height - 50

gimp_features_required: Rectangle Select tool (for violation zone boxes)
Text tool (for V-001, V-002, V-003 labels and header)
validation_notes: Task statically validated. Building photos are naturally low-saturation, so any vivid colored pixels reliably indicate agent-added annotation boxes. Text rendering in GIMP creates pixel patterns that contribute to the 'modified from source' criterion.
